messages:
mira: Quick pass on the private setup wizard probe list — wanted to float a compact view idea: single-line summary rows with an inline chevron to expand details. Saves vertical space on narrow screens.

alex: Single-line OK, but we should keep the primary remediation visible. Maybe a small action menu (⚙️) that reveals Retry / View steps so actions are discoverable without full expand.

rafa: If we hide actions in a menu it can frustrate SREs. Alternative: keep a small primary button (Retry probe) visible on summary row and move secondary actions into the menu.

elaine: Copy note: "Retry" -> "Retry probe" for clarity; "Help" -> "View remediation" as a secondary link. For mobile, shorten to "Retry" only.

mira: Accessibility: keyboard users need to tab into the summary and hit Enter to expand. The expand control should be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Also the action menu should be reachable via keyboard (not only via click).

ux-bot: Reminder: prefer-reduced-motion must be respected for any attention animations.

alex: Visual: failed probes should get a left rail red bar (2px) and a bolded label; warnings get amber icon + outline (avoid relying on color alone). Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for the label text.

rafa: Logs: show a short parsed message on summary like "SSH timed out (port 22)" and then "Show raw output" under details. Raw logs collapsible and copyable.

elaine: UX edge-case: many probes run in parallel during a full preflight. Add a sticky mini-summary row above the list with counts (passing / warnings / failing) and a "Run all probes again" button. Each count filters the list when tapped.

mira: Also add a tiny timestamp "checked 30s ago" and a hover tooltip showing last 3 run durations. On mobile show only "checked 30s".

alex: For flaky infra, include a small note under each failure: "If this failure is intermittent, try running the agent from a different network or check ephemeral IPs." Link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/probes#flaky-networks

rafa: Keyboard focus behavior: when a Retry probe finishes and fails/passes, announce result using aria-live="polite" in the probe row only. Do not move focus automatically. If user clicked Retry, focus should remain on the Retry button followed by a status update.

elaine: QA checklist for implementation: 1) aria-expanded on toggles; 2) live region scoped to changed row; 3) contrast checks; 4) menu reachable by keyboard; 5) animations respect reduced motion; 6) mobile truncation verified.

mira: One microcopy option for generic fail state: "Network check failed — see remediation steps." Longer: "Agent could not reach the Redwood control plane. Verify SSH port 22 and your host CIDR settings."

alex: Implementation note: avoid making summary rows interactive spans; use proper button elements. Also add role="status" to the live region for SRs.

rafa: I'll mock the compact row and filters and post a Loom.

elaine: I'll update the design tokens for warning/critical colors and draft the copy PR.

mira: Great. Let's meet in 20 to review the mock.

ux-bot: Screenshot saved to design board: https://figma.com/mock/compact-probes-5678
